easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying The Mighty Thor's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of The Mighty Thor's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.
